facts.text: The authority refused to grant building consent subject to a waiver from clause D1.3.3(i) for proposed isolated steps between student bedrooms and prefabricated pods.
The building is a multi-storey university student accommodation building.
Figure 1 shows the bedroom and ensuite pod arrangement with the isolated step.
Acceptable Solution D1/AS1 is cited as second edition, amendment 6.
